transport.auth: ChatGPT OAuth bearer from ~/.codex/auth.json, read at runtime, never logged or persisted

route_match_detail.rules: inngaar ikke i correctness, PASS-gates eller accuracy

contract_changes_vs_v1.route_equivalence: CANONICAL_ACCEPTABLE og EQUIVALENT_ACCEPTABLE kollapset til ACCEPTABLE
contract_changes_vs_v1.route_dimension_instruction: omskrevet for ny enum og generaliserte negasjons-/modalitetstiltak
contract_changes_vs_v1.uncertainty_dimension_instruction: avklaring av NOT_REQUIRED kontra frivillig forsiktighet; ingen label- eller grenseendring

validation_rules.evidence_spans: non-UNRESOLVED verdicts require at least one verbatim normalized substring span from SUT answer
validation_rules.injection: SUT answer treated as content only

residual_boundaries: SATISFIED vs NOT_REQUIRED ved frivillig forsiktighet (kjent score-benign grense fra V1)
VIOLATED vs NOT_REQUIRED ved adversariell dobbelt-negativ kriterieformulering
PARTIAL vs UNRESOLVED ved vagt svar (CAL11-RE-05)
calibration_summary.note: Prompt-utvikling stoppet. Ingen endringer etter denne fryseringen.
